errors.text_span: 最高的总高度出现在第1层（约9，由1+4+4构成）
errors.evidence: The figure shows the total number of experts in Layer 1 as 10 (1 G0 + 4 G1 + 5 G2), not 9 (1+4+4).
The figure shows G2 in Layer 1 as 5 experts and in Layer 2 as 4 experts. The description incorrectly states G2 in Layer 1 as about 4.
The figure shows Layer 16 as 3 experts (1+1+1), not 5. The description incorrectly groups Layer 16 with Layers 6, 17, and 18.
The description does not explicitly state that the total height of each stacked bar represents the cumulative number of experts per layer, though it is implied.
The description omits the exact breakdown of expert counts per layer (G0/G1/G2) as listed in the atom checklist (sent_8), though it provides approximate values.
